Native JSON proofs are separately retained. Reproduction compares 14 explicit product/audit hash entries; generated GitHub artifact URLs/IDs are synthetic.
acquisition_and_runtime_boundaries.checkout: ACT --bind used the actual clean source checkout at the daemon-visible absolute path; local actions/checkout optimization is not evidence of a fresh remote clone per job. Exact revision and clean status were recorded before and after every job.
acquisition_and_runtime_boundaries.network: Existing proxy/package mirrors/registry/TLS policy preserved; read-only combined CA and APT CaInfo snippet; exact bridge-reachable artifact/cache address appended to existing no-proxy lists.
acquisition_and_runtime_boundaries.publisher_authentication: No GITHUB_TOKEN fabricated; working injected Git/API auth is independent of unsupported dependency graph endpoint/provider action.
